The '''Ig'zxyck Flare''' was a criminal syndicate during the first [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], it was controlled by [[Jelasi]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
